submission.natural_language_explanation: openai-community/gpt2 L0/N138+ is a letter-T word-piece detector: its strength is set by the current token alone (token identity explains 99% of its variance and position 0%), and it fires when that token is a piece of a word built around a T — strongest on the bare ' T'/'T'/' t'/'t' token that GPT-2 splits off the front of a name, initialism, acronym or camelCase word (Troy, UNT, T cells, addTests, FullTensorProduct), then on T-initial fragments (' Tr', ' Te', ' Tok', ' tel') and rarer T-initial words (' Troy', ' Turing', ' Tunis', ' Tiffany'). It stays at the GELU floor (<= 0) for tokens that begin a word with any other letter (apart from a dozen mid-word fragments such as ' unt' and ' MT') and for the highest-frequency one-token T words, which never rise above 0 in the scan (' the', ' to', ' that', ' this', ' their', ' time', ' test', ' team', ' type', ' three', ' two', ' through', ' Trump', ' TV').
